title: Austin Gas Lights & Police Expansion
summary:
• **Gas Company Proposal**: The Creston Gas Light Company of New Orleans requested a 30-year exclusive contract to build gas works and light Congress Avenue and surrounding streets. A committee was appointed to investigate feasibility.

• **Police Force Increase**: The council unanimously approved hiring two additional police officers to improve city protection.

• **City Mapping Project**: A committee was tasked with evaluating the purchase of an official map of Austin from Mr. Klappenbuch, with the bill approved for payment.

• **Church Land for Colored Community**: The council unanimously approved allowing a church society to build a new church for Black residents on the same block as an existing colored church.

• **Standing Committees Established**: Six committees were appointed to oversee Finance, Fire Department, Parks, Cemetery, Market, and Police operations for the coming period.

Gentlemen

On behalf of the consolidated Creston
Gas Light Company of New Orleans Louisiana

We propose to erect works and furnish your City with good fixed Gas.
We ask of you the exclusive priveledge for Thirty years and a contract for as many Street
lights as you may designate on Congress Avenue from Water Street to the Capitol, and its
surroundings, on Pecan Street from Congress Avenue to East Avenue and such other places as
the consumption of Gas may warrant the extension of the pipes.
We would respectfully submit the above
to your favorable consideration and remain Very Truly
Austin, July 1st 1872. Your obt Srt
P. Massina
Alderman Brueggahoff offered the following Resolution Be it resolved by the City Council
of the City of Austin, that for the better protection of the City, the Mayor be requested
to increase the Police force by appointing two more policeman; the Resolution was adopted
by a unanimous vote.
Mr. Klappenbuch presented to the City Council a Map of the City of Austin for them to
purchase and Alderman Brueggerhoff offered the following resolution Be it resolved by the
City Council of Austin, that the Mayor be requested to appoint a Committee to investigate
the feasibility of the purchase. The resolution was adopted, this Hon the Mayor appointed
Alderman Brueggerhoff & S. L. Psaas.
Alderman Brueggerhoff offered the following resolution Be it resolved by the City Council
of the City of Austin, that the Bill of Mr. Klappenbuch for the City Maps be registered
and audited for payment; the resolution was adopted by a unanimous vote.
Alderman Brueggerhoff offered the following resolution Be it resolved by the City Council
of the City of Austin, that in the consideration, that Mrs. [illegible] [illegible]
discontinued her theatre within the first six months, that they had taken out License for,
and the first two payments having been made leaving two Notes of $62 [illegible] each
unpaid, it is hereby resolved that the said two Notes be given to Mrs S. L. Psaas as he
was security for the same. The Resolution passed by a unanimous vote

the City of Austin, that the Committee appointed to select a site for the erection of a
church for the colored people be instructed to allow the said Church society to erect a
church in the rear of the other colored church and on the same block The resolution was
